searches: site:community.fortinet.com/fortigate-3 WebSocket inspection DLP AV IPS proxy after:2026-10-17
FortiGate Copilot Explicit Proxy HTTP 414 max-request-length WebSocket
results.finding: After 7.6.8, Copilot WebSocket handshakes returned 414; UTM allowed traffic but explicit proxy denied a long URI. This is a proxy-length failure before WebSocket frame inspection, not a UTM block.

searches: FortiManager FDS connectivity tunnel mode 443 proxy mode 80
results.finding: A 503/504 FDS failure with an upstream proxy distinguishes tunnel-mode TCP/443 from proxy-mode TCP/80; AV/IPS service enablement is also required on affected releases.

searches: site:community.fortinet.com/fortianalyzer-6 FortiWeb alert playbook FortiGate action after:2026-10-17
results.finding: FortiWeb-originated alerts need a FortiAnalyzer playbook to trigger action on a different FortiGate; the scenario exposes trigger scope and input mapping boundaries.
A standalone switch in an L2-extended network can still be adopted because CAPWAP AC discovery remains active after auto-ISL and auto-FortiLink discovery are disabled.

searches: FortiAP RADIUS authentication debug wpad station logs
results.finding: The troubleshooting article provides station-filter, wpad debug and UDP/1812/1813 capture evidence to isolate AP, FortiGate, RADIUS server and client failures; no direct recent survivability case surfaced.

searches: site:community.fortinet.com/fortinac-28 Kerberos FortiNAC authentication Winbind MSCHAPv2
results.finding: The updated domain-join/MSCHAPv2 article demonstrates that LDAP lookup success does not prove Winbind trust or Kerberos authentication; no direct recent Kerberos admin-login case surfaced.

searches: site:community.fortinet.com/fortinac-f-57 Entra ID group import description after:2026-10-17
results.finding: Entra ID group import fails when description exceeds 255 characters; AzureADApplicationInterface debug and output.master SQL error identify the exact sync boundary.
A node-specific gateway can override static routing after reboot; this is a routing dependency that remains separate from HA priority and failback selection.

searches: site:community.fortinet.com/fortipam-52 JIT checkout check-in Add-LocalGroupMember WinRM after:2026-10-17
results.finding: When Launch secrets with PAM credentials is used, $[0].$USER can be empty; the resulting missing Member argument is a variable-resolution problem, not an Add-LocalGroupMember permission denial.

searches: site:community.fortinet.com/fortisiem-34 event name overwritten event type parser FortiSIEM
results.finding: A 7.5.1 parser test/live-event discrepancy shows why parser normalization must be validated before post-parse Event Tagging; no recent direct tagging rule case surfaced.

searches: site:community.fortinet.com/fortisase-58 ZTNA destination IPv6 DNS FortiClient after:2026-10-17
results.finding: FQDN-based ZTNA destinations stall when IPv6 DNS is attempted before IPv4 fallback; literal IP destinations avoid the DNS proxy path, clarifying the IP-range feature's operational value.

searches: site:community.fortinet.com/fortigate-3 OaaS failed to delete zone FortiCloud overlay
results.finding: OaaS deployment can fail when a pre-existing SD-WAN service occupies default ID 1; the default oaas_default service needs the ID, so migrate the existing rule before retrying.

coverage_note: All twelve product areas were queried. Five directly relevant Community scenarios were within the rolling 30-day window; older relevant scenarios are retained where no newer feature-specific case was found and are clearly dated in the report.
